verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant build audiences, manage and create syncs, design journeys, generate emails and ads, and analyze performance in plain language, with concrete example prompts. Its docs also describe a built-in agent for exploring segments and analyzing campaigns in natural language, and Ad Studio generates creatives from prompts that can be refined with follow-up instructions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably, and evidence that NL control extends to other areas such as models and identity resolution (the built-in agent's documented scope covers only exploration and analysis).
